message.content:
1) Yes, the layout follows the standard YouTube structure (top bar, left rail, chip filter bar, and a grid of video cards).
2) No, there is no large hero or settings panel between the chips and the grid; only a small "For you" text header is present.
3) Yes, the cards display real photographic thumbnails of nature and people.
4) Duration/type info appears as a corner badge overlaid on the bottom-right of the thumbnail.
5) Yes: The branding is "WebFlix" instead of YouTube; there is an "Install WebFlix" PWA prompt in the bottom right; and the action buttons include "Queue" and "Share" directly on the card face.
